subject: INV-3341: proposed sweep date and tax docs needed
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Aurelia Therapeutics AP <ap@aurelia.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 24 Jun 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: INV-3341: proposed sweep date and tax docs needed

Hi Marta / Aurelia AP team,

Following up on invoice INV-3341 (May services). Our records show the invoice is outstanding and we have a tentative sweep planned for the week of 2028-07-07. To complete the remittance we'd need two items from your side: a copy of your PO/approval (if available) and confirmation of the payment rail you prefer (ACH to our US account, EUR wire to the EU entity, or virtual card).

Logistics / options:
- ACH (US) — fastest if your AP can initiate before 07-07; we can provide ACH details.
- Wire (EUR) — we can accept wire to our EU bank; please confirm banker name and value date.
- Virtual card — accept if card retry is easier for you (we can re-send the card capture link).

Tax docs: we also need a signed Supplier W-9 on file for US tax purposes and, if you require, a VAT-compliant invoice for your EU AP team. I’m attaching the invoice PDF and a W-9 we have on file — please confirm whether the W-9 is sufficient or if you need an EU VAT invoice.

If you can confirm the rail and a projected payment date by Monday 2028-06-26, we’ll keep the sweep window; otherwise we’ll schedule an interim remediation call. Happy to take a short call if useful.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: INV-3341-Redwood.pdf, Supplier_W9_2028.pdf
From: Marta Lopez <ap@aurelia.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: treasurer@aurelia.com
Date: Sun, 25 Jun 2028 19:02:00 +0200
Subject: Re: INV-3341: proposed sweep date and tax docs needed

Hi Diego — thanks for the note.

Quick status: our payment attempt via virtual card failed yesterday (card declined). Our AP prefers to pay by EUR wire for cross-border invoices. We can target value date 2028-07-07 but need your wire instructions and an EU-format invoice (VAT number and tax breakdown) to route through Treasury.

Also attaching our PO reference (PO-7792). We will need a signed supplier W-9 for our records as well — the one you sent looks like Redwood’s template; please confirm it’s the official signed version on file. If you can send wire instructions and the VAT invoice by end of day Monday 2028-06-26 we’ll prioritize the wire.

Marta Lopez
AP Manager, Aurelia Therapeutics
ap@aurelia.com

Attachments: PO-7792.pdf
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <ap@aurelia.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jun 2028 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: INV-3341: proposed sweep date and tax docs needed

Hi Marta — appreciate the quick reply and the PO.

We can accommodate a EUR wire with value date 2028-07-07. I’ve attached a short bank-details stub (Bank_Details_Redwood.txt) and an updated EU-style invoice that includes VAT fields. The W-9 attached is the signed version we have on file; if you require anything else for your tax team let us know.

To avoid any late fees we’ll waive the standard 1% late fee if payment clears by 2028-07-07 — I’m sending an amendment (DocuSign link below) that confirms the waiver and the agreed remittance date. If your treasury needs a different remittance reference, tell us now and we’ll reissue.

If wire is the plan, please confirm the transaction reference once initiated so our cash application team can match it quickly. If you prefer we can also accept an interim virtual-card retry to accelerate settlement.

Thanks again — copying Priyom (collections) to coordinate the match and Mina (finance) for VAT invoice delivery.

Best,
Diego

Attachments: Bank_Details_Redwood.txt, INV-3341-Redwood-EU-invoice.pdf
Related links: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/EXAMPLE-INV3341-WS
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jun 2028 15:12:00 +01:00
Subject: Internal: Aurelia request — VAT evidence & sweep coordination

Internal note / ask:

Aurelia confirmed wire as preferred rail with a target value date 2028-07-07 but needs an EU-format VAT invoice and the signed supplier W-9 for their records. They included PO-7792. Action items:

1) Mina — please generate and sign the EU VAT invoice (include VAT breakdown and Redwood EU VAT reg no.). Send final PDF to Marta and copy me and Priyom. Target: EOD 2028-06-26 (we missed that but EOD 2028-06-27 is acceptable).
2) Priyom — monitor for the incoming wire on 2028-07-07 and watch for remittance reference. If funds not received by close of business 07-07, escalate to Ben for reconciliation and fee discussion.
3) Ben — prepare a short waiver amendment (DocuSign) confirming late fee will be waived if funds clear by 07-07; attach to the invoice email if needed.

I’ve attached the invoice variant we sent and the bank stub. We’ll keep the sweep window that week but want to avoid opening a long collection path. If anything changes (card retry, PO mismatch, or treasury asks for different entity routing) escalate immediately.

Diego
Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments (internal): INV-3341-Redwood-EU-invoice.pdf, Bank_Details_Redwood.txt, late-fee-waive-amendment-docusign.pdf
